provenance.dataset_status: CMR-derived MEIDNet-format dataset; newly generated splits

test_set_use: aggregate dataset statistics only; no model execution or selection

grouping.algorithm: sort material IDs; group by reduced composition; seeded group shuffle; greedy remaining-capacity assignment
grouping.assignment_rule_verified: each seeded-shuffled whole group is assigned to the split with the largest target_rows-minus-current_rows capacity; ties follow train/val/test order
grouping.group_key: composition_group (reduced composition from source site symbols)
